each pass takes ParsedEntry plus &mut ClusterContext[C, L] plus &SymbolTables -> Result[(), CheckError]

Workers park inside scheduler wait_* — never inside library code. See facades/int.md "process_cluster — the cluster-atomic orchestration loop".
